what: Next to section titles, a thin bar line like a sound level meter (15rem × 24px, 6px pitch, 2px bars) always ripples gently. Bar height is three seed-set peaks (√sin shape, with low dotted-line-like gaps between) × (.45 + .55·|sin(seed·20 + time × .002~.005)|), and the faster you scroll (1 at 40px per frame, following by .08) the more it surges, .8 → 1x. Each meter’s seed differs by 13.7, so the shapes differ. Only visible ones are drawn, at 30fps

options.seed: Shape seed — if omitted, 13.7 is added in order of attachment

note: The bar color reads the element’s color on every draw. Under reduced motion it stays still in its initial shape

from.where: index.html six meters beside section titles (original Brand meter — 24px·6px·2px · scroll speed /40 · .08 · 30fps)
